text:
garrett: @channel Heads-up — SecretsBridge (SI) is ready to list our HSM-backed connector in AWS Marketplace and we want a joint announcement + blog. Need cross-team sync: SSO/SAML metadata exchange, SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM onboarding docs, secrets manager integration, compliance blurb, and the joint announcement timeline. Proposed launch: 2024-11-15. Who can own which pieces?

neha: +1. From eng: I can own SAML metadata & SCIM provisioning tests. ETA ~2 weeks. Will need STS access to SecretsBridge test tenant and a test HSM key ARN.

liz: I'll handle PR/marketing assets + press contacts. Can we lock an embargo for 2024-11-15? Need legal signoff by 11/01 to make that work. :calendar: 

kyle: Security checklist items I want covered: HSM attestation, KMS key policies, rotation plan, and audit log shipping. I'll run the HSM onboarding runbook — need SecretsBridge device certs and key ARN format.

garrett: Action owners (proposed):
1) neha - SAML metadata + SCIM provisioning tests (2w)
2) kyle - HSM attestation & KMS policy template (1.5w)
3) liz - draft joint blog & marketplace listing copy (2w)
4) marie - partner ops coordination & confirm MSA/NDA
Please add calendar invites and ping if blocked.

marie: NDA/MSA status: OK on our side. I'll confirm their legal signature + pricing/SKU mapping for marketplace listing.

neha: Quick SCIM example to share with SecretsBridge for testing: 
```json
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName":"alice@corp.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Li"}
}
```
Test endpoint they can use: https://secretsbridge-test.example/scim

kyle: KMS policy snippet for documentation: `"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01"}]`
Also: require CloudTrail logs delivered to a secure bucket and keys with rotation enabled.

liz: Marketing requests a 2–3 bullet TL;DR for the listing page — usuable on the AWS tile. Example asks: HSM-backed keys, audit logs, SSO provisioning, turnkey marketplace deploy. Can eng drop polished bullets here?

garrett: Tentative timeline constraints: legal by 2024-11-01, eng bake by 2024-11-08, marketing assets by 2024-11-10, marketplace listing ready 2024-11-12, embargo lift 2024-11-15. If anyone expects slippage, flag now so we can plan a canary.

partners-bot: Created event "SecretsBridge marketplace launch sync" 2024-10-25 14:00 PT — invites: garrett, neha, kyle, liz, marie, secretsbridge-rep

neha: Can SecretsBridge provide a test HSM key ARN and a small sample config for our docs? Pinged their eng channel.

secretsbridge-rep: Hi team — we'll provide a test ARN + sample config by EOD tomorrow. Also attaching a prefilled marketplace listing draft for you to review (will DM link).

kyle: Short docs checklist for the public docs page (for engineering to populate):
- How to connect KMS/HSM (ARN + role assumptions)
- SSO/SAML metadata exchange steps (XML + ACS)
- SCIM provisioning example (with error codes)
- Troubleshooting (403s, token rotation, role issues)
- Support & escalation contact details

liz: I'll assemble the first draft of the listing copy and joint blog. Can someone paste the final TL;DR bullets?

garrett: TL;DR bullets for listing (drop-in):
- "Enterprise-grade keys: HSM-backed keys with rotation & audit logs"
- "One-click marketplace deployment + automated SCIM provisioning"
- "SAML SSO & role-based access for organizations"

marie: Looping in legal: @sarah-legal — can you confirm signoff timeline? We need sign-off by 2024-11-01.

sarah-legal: Reviewing the MSA addendum this week. Target to sign by 2024-10-30. I'll call out any redlines by EOD Friday.

garrett: Great — next steps: update the checklist in Confluence (https://redwood-internal/confluence/partners/secretsbridge), schedule the staging dry-run deploy on 2024-11-05, and plan a final go/no-go on 2024-11-12. Thanks everyone — will follow up with the calendar invite and the draft PR copy later today.
